reply:
Async functions run on the main thread. They don't spawn threads; they're just syntactic sugar for promises that let the event loop schedule other tasks between await points. CPU-heavy work will still freeze the UI even if it's in an async function because it's blocking the main thread directly.

Web Workers are the correct solution here. They run in a separate actual thread and won't block the main UI thread while doing CPU work.

The concrete cost of my earlier answer: your UI stays frozen. A user perceives an unresponsive app.
